content.label:
This app is super helpful for someone that lives with Multiple Sclerosis and needs relief and/or assistance for writing messages or emails or health data or everyday tasks that allow me to participate in life with a greater ease.
It’s streamlined, has an excellent user interface and provides less stress on my physical and mental health. 
Thanks so much for taking the initiative to create this app — not knowing how effective this could be for people with health problems and/or disabilities.
